band_change_evidence_test.requirement: >=2 independent sources with >=1 at sourceTier >= 4, excluding self-published corporate material
band_change_evidence_test.explanation: Three independent sources support the band change, of which one sits at tier 4: CNBC's report of the whistleblower lawsuit. Interesting Engineering (tier 3) and a technology review of Figure 03's safety specification (tier 2) provide corroboration. Figure AI's own news pages were excluded as self-published.

key_evidence: **Why it matters: the benchmark publishes two different scores for Figure AI.** The ai-labs record was assessed and moved to 31.3 on 19 June 2026. The robotics-labs record still sits at the untouched 48.4 placeholder — a 17.1-point gap for one company.

**A safety engineer's lawsuit against Figure AI has not been decided in court.** Robert Gruendel filed suit on 21 November 2025 alleging he was fired for raising safety warnings. Figure says he was let go for poor performance. This assessment records the dispute and does not score the allegations as established.

**Figure does publish real safety engineering detail for its home robot.** Figure 03 uses soft washable textiles, multi-density foam over pinch points, and a battery certified to UN38.3. This is the company's single strongest compassion-relevant disclosure.
**Figure publishes no responsibility report, grievance data or outcome measurement.** Roughly 32 of the 40 scores rest on absence of disclosure.
**The correction here is a measurement fix, not an accusation.** No regulatory finding, safety recall or court judgment against Figure AI was located.
corporate_status: Operating. Privately held, Sunnyvale, California. CROSS-INDEX DUPLICATE DEFECT: Figure AI also holds an ai-labs record, assessed on 2026-06-19 at composite 31.3. The ai-labs record was NOT opened or modified by this study. The robotics-labs record proposed here is 25.6. The benchmark should decide which index owns this company.

scoring_convention: 2-convention: absence of disclosure scores 2, never 1. A score of 1 requires positive documented evidence of a specific failure. Absence of disclosure is NOT evidence of harm.
notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — SEED CORRECTION, NOT A CONDUCT DOWNGRADE. The published 48.4 is a never-assessed uniform placeholder shared byte-for-byte with five other labs at consecutive alphabetical ranks 32 to 37. IMPORTANT: the Gruendel whistleblower lawsuit filed on 21 November 2025 in the Northern District of California has NOT been decided in court as of August 2026, and Figure AI denies the claims. This assessment records the dispute as context and does NOT score its allegations as established facts. No subdimension was reduced because of it. Roughly 32 of 40 subdimensions score at the low anchor because no disclosure exists. No score change is applied by this study, and no change is proposed to the ai-labs record.
